textoCompleto:
Insulin Calculation

CALCULATOR

Fast and safe calculator for drawing up International Units (IU).

Insulin Calculator
The concentration is independent of the syringe size. If the presentation is not U-100, do not use this version of the calculator.

The syringe size does not change the insulin concentration.

Basic Measurements and Proportions
Mathematical examples for U-100 (100 IU/mL):

100 IU equals 1.0 mL

50 IU equals 0.5 mL

30 IU equals 0.3 mL

10 IU equals 0.1 mL

Safety Tip: 
Use the syringe compatible with the presentation and the graduation indicated in the applicable protocol. The selection of the syringe size does not change the product concentration.
